name: Palmer Foodservice
old_description: Experience three generations of Foodservice and Product Distribution
about:
Palmer Foodservice, a family-owned and operated full-line foodservice distributor, has been based in Shelbyville, Tennessee since its founding in 1948 by Jack Palmer Sr. The company remains under the stewardship of the Palmer family, with Jack and Annette Palmer, Mac and Mary Carol Palmer, and Jack Palmer, Mary Carol Palmer, and Liza Palmer Gipson involved in leadership.

The distributor operates a state-of-the-art facility featuring a wireless warehouse management system with barcode scanning and voice selection, temperature-controlled receiving docks, and refrigerated and freezer storage units. It serves middle Tennessee, northern Alabama, and southern Kentucky, leveraging proximity to Interstates 24 and 65 for quick turnaround delivery, and offers a Cash & Carry program for local customers. Beyond distribution of beverages, labeled products, and produce as a Unipro Plus distributor, Palmer Foodservice provides sales consulting and pricing strategy support, and manages branded programs such as Little Italy and Broaster Chicken.

Its customer base includes grocery and convenience store delis, local restaurants, day cares, concession stands, water parks, and other foodservice operators. The company emphasizes product availability and inventory tracking for date-sensitive items.

Founded on principles of service, responsibility to the customer, and dedication to quality established by Jack Palmer Sr., the company's mission is to provide excellent customer service and premium quality food products at a fair price, a tradition it describes as a family commitment spanning over six decades.
